data.notes: August 2026 is unusually dense in Amsterdam, with WorldPride spillover, major electronic festivals, classical/jazz programming, and arena pop/hip-hop shows all confirmed.

events.title: Dekmantel Festival 2026
events.venueName: Amsterdamse Bos, Melkweg, Paradiso, Oude Kerk
events.summary: Dekmantel’s 12th edition runs July 29–August 2, with 160+ electronic acts and expanded city programming. Confirmed artists include DARKSIDE, Helena Hauff, Ricardo Villalobos, Skrillex, Underground Resistance featuring Saul Williams, and Ron Trent.

events.title: Loveland Festival 2026
events.summary: Loveland Festival returns to Sloterpark on August 8–9 with a major house and techno lineup. Resident Advisor lists Eric Prydz, Fatboy Slim, Ben Klock, Sven Väth, Robert Hood, Joris Voorn, Nicole Moudaber, Hot Since 82, Sasha & John Digweed, and many more.

events.title: World Pride Music Festival
events.summary: A two-night WorldPride music event at AFAS Live, confirmed for July 31 and August 1. The venue describes the programme as featuring global headliners, DJs, and high-production performances, with the detailed timetable still unavailable.

events.title: WorldPride Closing Concert
events.summary: The closing concert for Amsterdam WorldPride’s Museumplein programme is confirmed for August 8 from 18:00 to 00:00. Artist details were not yet published on the source page.

events.title: Ratherlost - 24 Hours
events.summary: Ratherlost’s 20th gathering is a 24-hour full-venue Lofi ritual spanning darker techno, dubby morning grooves and sun-soaked progressive sounds, with artists including D.Dan, JakoJako live, Kangding Ray, Kia, Luke Vibert, Priori and Spekki Webu.

events.title: WorldPride UNITY Concert
events.summary: One of three large WorldPride concerts on Museumplein, confirmed by the City of Amsterdam for August 4 from 18:00 to 00:00. Artist details were not yet listed on the source page.

events.title: WorldPride Wedding Party XXL
events.summary: A WorldPride Museumplein concert event confirmed by the City of Amsterdam for August 6 from 18:00 to 00:00. The listing confirms the event and venue, but not the performer lineup.

events.title: Grachtenfestival 2026
events.summary: Grachtenfestival runs August 7–16 and presents young classical and jazz talent across Amsterdam. The source states that ticket sales and the programme will follow from June 19.

events.title: 12HRS Adonis x SPIELRAUM
events.summary: A 12-hour WorldPride collaboration between London queer institution Adonis and Amsterdam’s SPIELRAUM, part of CLUB RAUM’s DESIRE Pride programme.

events.title: Tropikali BY NIGHT | Worldpride Amsterdam
events.summary: Tropikali’s WorldPride closing night at Paradiso revives Rosario with Latin-spiced house/electronic sounds and Kalinichta’s Balkan, SWANA and Arabic-house energy.

events.title: SPIELRAUM ...IsBurning
events.summary: SPIELRAUM and IsBurning reunite for a WorldPride daytime Courtyard takeover at Lofi, billed for house and techno with a secret lineup.

events.title: RADION invites Gegen
events.summary: Berlin-born queer/fetish rave brand Gegen returns to RADION for WorldPride with BOYCA, Boris, Yigit, Mila Haj Kasem, Mar/us, Nymed b2b Spikey Lee and Shadysnack.

events.title: SLPFNK 15 YEAR AMS TOUR - BIRTHDAY WEEKENDER
events.summary: SlapFunk’s 15-year Amsterdam tour closes with a birthday weekender across Lofi and BRET, framed as the final stop of its anniversary club tour.

events.title: A$AP Rocky - Don’t Be Dumb World Tour
events.summary: A$AP Rocky plays Ziggo Dome on August 27 at 19:30 on the Don’t Be Dumb World Tour. Ticketmaster confirms the Amsterdam date and venue.

events.title: ZeeZout Festival 2026
events.summary: ZeeZout Festival is confirmed for August 29 at Tuinen van West from 13:00 to 23:00. The lineup includes 36framez, Bad Boombox, Benwal, Carista, Dr Dubplate, Mall Grab, Naone, Surusinghe, Thelma, and more.

events.title: Bashkka curates
events.summary: A CLUB RAUM Pride-week curation by BASHKKA with 36framez, Clarisa Kimskii, Juliana Huxtable and more, positioned within RAUM’s DESIRE series.

events.title: Pride ...IsBurning
events.summary: IsBurning’s WorldPride Saturday night takeover at Lofi, billed as a hot, steamy house-and-techno Pride party with a surprise lineup.

events.title: JOJI: SOLARIS
events.summary: Joji brings the SOLARIS tour to Ziggo Dome on August 25 at 20:00. Ticketmaster lists Joji with Tommy Richman on the Amsterdam date.

events.title: BINI: Signals World Tour
events.summary: Filipino girl group BINI brings the Signals World Tour to AFAS Live on August 30, with doors at 18:30 and showtime at 20:00. The venue page describes their sound as global pop with layered vocals in English and Tagalog.

events.title: Peaches at Club Chrome
events.summary: Peaches performs at Melkweg MAX on August 7 as part of Club Chrome, Melkweg’s WorldPride 2026 programme. The event page highlights her work as a feminist musician, producer, director, and performance artist.
